rows.note: Use 虛弱 as a written noun for the physical condition of lacking strength.

example.english: They still have some physical weakness after being ill.
example.traditional: 佢病完之後仲有少少虛弱。
example.jyutping: keoi5 beng6 jyun4 zi1 hau6 zung6 jau5 siu2 siu2 heoi1 joek6

rows.note: Use 弱點 as the all-purpose noun for a vulnerability or area where someone is weak.

example.english: This team's biggest weakness is its defense.
example.traditional: 呢隊波最大嘅弱點係後防。
example.jyutping: ni1 deoi6 bo1 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 joek6 dim2 hai6 hau6 fong4

rows.note: Use 缺點 specifically when the weakness is an inadequacy or personal fault rather than a vulnerable point.

example.jyutping: cou1 sam1 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 daai6 ge3 kyut3 dim2

rows.jyutping: deoi3 A mou5 dai2 kong3 lik6
rows.note: Use this construction for a fondness so strong that someone cannot resist the thing.

example.english: I have a weakness for desserts.
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 tim4 ban2 mou5 dai2 kong3 lik6
